name: Drop Object
text: Drop Object Force target wizard to drop 1 treasure or carried item of your choice. 2

name: Pick Lock
text: Pick Lock Mundane Unlock target door momentarily. The door re-locks after you pass through it, although you may "hold the door open" for others while you are adjacent to the door. Mundane actions cannot be countered. A 3

name: Create Wall
text: CREATE WALL Creation Create a 1-square-long section of stone wall on a target border line between 2 squares. Stone walls take 5 cracks to destroy. Create Wall cannot be cast on a border line that is already occupied (i.e., there cannot already be a wall or door there).

name: Rotate Sector
text: Rotate Sector Rotate target sector board in either direction by 90° or 180°.

name: Zot!
text: Zot! Deal magical damage to target object, wizard, or creature equal to this spell’s energy. -or- Stun target wizard or creature for 2 turns.

name: Full Shield
text: Full Shield Cancel 1 target spell targeting you as it is cast. A

name: Large Rock
text: LARGE ROCK Thrown Weapon While carrying this item, you may throw this hefty rock as an attack at target object, wizard, or creature for 2 physical damage. After hitting the target, the rock falls to the ground in the target’s square (if possible), where it can be picked up. 3

name: Dispel
text: Dispel Immediately end 1 target non-instant spell, as well as any spells affecting that spell.

name: Destroy Wall
text: DESTROY WALL Destroy either a 1-square-long section of target wall or 1 target door. Any wizard or creature adjacent to target wall (or door) suffers 2 physical damage. This spell is not an attack and cannot be evaded. A

name: Around the Corner
text: AROUND THE CORNER Aim one target spell you cast around one corner (up to 180°). A

name: Negate Neutral
text: Negate Neutral Cancel 1 target neutral spell as it is cast. A
